open_issues.impact: scripts/test-ecosystem-units.py expectation of the bridge list
open_issues.text: The stale bridge expectation in scripts/test-ecosystem-units.py predates this piece (gui bridges were registered earlier); it was fixed here because the file is in the write set and V9 runs it. The class RealRepositoryTests passes; the remaining tests of the file passed in the red run and were not touched.

summary: Correction for the red V9: the only failing check was scripts/test-ecosystem-units.py::RealRepositoryTests.test_modules_and_aliases, whose expected bridge list (orch-harness, orch-skiller, planner-orch) was stale because the gui bridges gui-hub, gui-orch and gui-planner are already registered in the hub; the test now expects all six bridges. Nothing else changed. Ran: python3 scripts/test-ecosystem-units.py RealRepositoryTests (6 tests, OK).
